text:
mira: FYI support flagged a customer who got charged twice for a single streaming completion. They gave us session_id=0xdeadbeef and a short timeline. Can we triage?

jamal: Do we have the router/runtime trace for that session? Need to see if it was a reconnect vs a mid-request model downgrade.

mira: Pasted excerpt from support logs: ```
2026-03-10T09:11:02Z client CONNECT session=0xdeadbeef route=primary region=us-east-1
2026-03-10T09:11:05Z router INFO session=0xdeadbeef model=gpt-open-8k prefix_tokens=198
2026-03-10T09:11:07Z runtime WARN toolcall id=tc-77 truncated=true tokens=64
2026-03-10T09:11:08Z router ERROR session=0xdeadbeef fallback=us-east-1b reason=route_preempt
2026-03-10T09:11:09Z router INFO session=0xdeadbeef resume=secondary stitch=attempted
2026-03-10T09:11:10Z runtime INFO toolcall id=tc-77 tokens=98 confirmed=true
2026-03-10T09:11:11Z billing INFO provisional token_claim session=0xdeadbeef tokens=162
2026-03-10T09:11:12Z billing INFO confirmed token_claim session=0xdeadbeef tokens=260
```

rachel: Notably billing claimed 162 provisional then confirmed 260. Looks like both the truncated chunk and resumed suffix got confirmed. stitch=attempted shows up.

alex: This is similar to prior stitch issues but with a route_preempt (preemption) not model_swap. Could be a scheduler eviction -> fallback resume race causing both fragments to be treated as independent toolcalls.

jamal: One important nuance: the toolcall id here (tc-77) is the same across the truncated and resumed entries. Billing should dedupe by toolcall id ideally, but current join logic uses a combination of session+chunk offsets which can break if resume path rewrites offsets.

samar: If billing deduped on toolcall id (and trusted id flow), we could avoid confirmed double charge. But we need to be careful: some old clients don't preserve toolcall id on reconnect and runtime might generate a new id.

mira: Support impact: customer quota usage showed two consumption events and they hit a soft quota threshold incorrectly. They opened a refund request.

alex: Short-term mitigation suggestions: 1) billing-side dedupe by toolcall id when present, with a heuristic fallback for missing ids; 2) mark stitch attempts in telemetry and surface in console as "resume_stitch" events; 3) support-runbook: ask for session id and issue provisional hold/refund while we investigate.

rachel: Console UX: add a small timeline row for route transitions with tags (preempt, model_swap, network_reconnect) and show provisional vs confirmed tokens per row. That will make support triage much faster.

jamal: Operational plan: I'll open a small patch to billing that dedupes confirmed entries if they share toolcall id OR (same session && suffix overlaps prefix and timestamp delta < 5s). Mark as hotfix P0.

samar: I'll audit runtime to ensure we propagate stable toolcall ids across reconnects where possible. If older clients are the issue we can add a bridge header to accept client-provided id.

mira: Also we should check quota enforcement: provisional charges should be counted against soft quota but allow some grace until confirmed; but if provisional is duplicated that can block clients incorrectly. Maybe add a provisional de-dup cache keyed by session+toolcall id for short window.

alex: Good point. Add a short TTL cache in quota service to squash identical provisional claims within 10s for the same session. That reduces false quota hits.

rachel: I'll prototype the console mock and include the timeline + provisional/confirmed badge. Also include a filter for "stitch_attempted" so support can find affected sessions quickly.

deploy-bot: Created PLAT-1399 "Hotfix: billing dedupe on streaming toolcall id + quota provisional dedupe cache" https://redwoodproj/PLAT-1399

jamal: Plan for rollout: cherry-pick hotfix to canary, monitor double-confirm rate metric, then roll to 5%/25%/100% if clean. I'll add an alert for spike in confirmed>provisional ratio.

alex: Who owns the console change? 

rachel: I'll own it and coordinate with design/devex. Won't be in hotfix but want it in next sprint.

mira: Support note: for any refunds before fix, please collect session_id and timestamps and add to PLAT-1399 ticket. We'll reconcile once billing hotfix lands.

jamal: Adding a telemetry event field route_handoff_type and stitch_outcome (attempted/claimed/failed) to help post-mortems. PR incoming.

alex: OK team — prioritize billing hotfix then runtime propagation. Keep this channel updated with PR links and canary metrics. Thanks. :thumbsup:
